newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down three cents to 15.03 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down three cents to 15.03 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell three cents to 15.03 ringgit ($6.03) a kg despite a higher overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There were higher offerings today and the market did not take its cue from the LME," said a dealer. The LME rose $5 on Wednesday.
Turnover rose marginally to 114 tonnes from 113 on Tuesday. Bids totalled 86 tonnes against offers of 147. The local premium eased to $30 from $45. Buyers were Europeans and locals.
